problem: 精确拆分用户 HUD 截图中的外圈、符纸和广告 Icon，同时保留原始像素、坐标、边缘和透明度。

candidates.name: Krita
candidates.risk: Do not ship Krita or its plugins in the game; use it only as a local authoring tool. Exported artwork remains the user's work.
attributionDuties: If Krita binaries or modified Krita code are redistributed, retain GPL notices; no Krita code enters the game runtime.
approvedScope: Manual layer/mask construction when a user authorizes masking or supplies a layered source; inspect at 100% zoom before export.

candidates.name: GIMP
candidates.risk: The GitHub repository is a read-only mirror of GNOME's GitLab source; use a tagged release and avoid untrusted plugins/scripts.
attributionDuties: If GIMP binaries or modified GIMP code are redistributed, preserve GPL/LGPL and component notices; no GIMP code enters the game runtime.
approvedScope: Manual path/selection and layer-mask authoring; deterministic export after measured reference coordinates are locked.

candidates.name: ImageMagick
candidates.risk: It cannot decide the correct foreground boundary; never use color removal as proof of a correct layer. Pin a release for automation and process only trusted local files.
attributionDuties: Include the ImageMagick license/acknowledgement if the software itself is redistributed; generated image outputs are not ImageMagick code.
approvedScope: Export from manually verified masks/crops, preserve reference-space offsets, generate three-background alpha QA composites.

candidates.name: SLImTAG
capabilities: mask save/load with original image position
candidates.risk: The optional SAM/connected-component paths are segmentation guesses and can alter the boundary; current strict pixel-preserving mode does not permit them without explicit manual-mask approval.
attributionDuties: Retain MIT copyright and permission notice if the tool or code is redistributed.

candidates.name: sprite-slicer
candidates.risk: Designed for transparent sprite sheets or regular grids; it does not solve layer separation in an opaque HUD screenshot and its background-removal option would be an unverified approximation here.
attributionDuties: Retain the selected MIT or Apache-2.0 notice if the crate is redistributed.

recommendedWorkflow: Krita or GIMP for human-controlled masks/layers
ImageMagick for exact coordinate export and QA
no automatic segmentation in strict mode
conclusion.currentBlocker: The authoritative talisman crop is RGB 478x494 with alpha unavailable; ring/talisman/ad runtime PNGs lack user-confirmed source mapping.
conclusion.nextRequiredInput: A transparent PNG for each layer or a Figma/PSD file with separate layers; alternatively explicit approval for a manual-mask approximation.
